proved: For public positive-definite Gaussian covariance, the public minimum-variance annihilator is computable by linear algebra and has variance no larger than every valid witness functional.
For the Run-63 OR2 Boolean-quotient fixture with isotropic covariance, lambda*=(1,1/3,1/3,-1/3) has squared norm 4/3 versus witness squared norms 2,2,4.

For an r-variable OR clause and any nonempty proper T, the signed Walsh functional lambda_T(S)=(-1)^{|S intersect T|} annihilates the clause-falsity mask, maps the key direction to one, and is not a Boolean witness evaluation.
Under iid sign-symmetric coefficient noise, the signed public dual has exactly the same residual noise distribution as the valid all-ones witness.
implemented: Exact rational linear algebra for public covariance minimization.
Random exact covariance controls and a Gaussian Monte Carlo diagnostic.
not_claimed: No generic impossibility theorem for modular LWE/SIS short-dual constructions.
No arbitrary-QPT early-recovery to source-witness reduction.
No security conclusion from Monte Carlo tests.
No claim that the single OR-clause fixture by itself is a hard-witness counterexample.
